title: Payment methods authorization created
description: This event represents a payment methods authorization request. This can be a request to a purchase authorization but also to a cancellation or confirmation. This is differentiated by the MTI of the operation.

tracking_id.title: Tracking ID of the authorization
tracking_id.description: Unique tracking id used to identify an authorization request. If payment methods API doesn't receive one, it will generate a new one and the request will be handled as a new Request. Different requests using the same tracking id will be considered the same request and will return the same result.

category.title: Event Category
category.description: Describe the action this event represents over an Authorization.

mti.title: Message Type Identifier
mti.description: It will identify if it is an Authorization, Cancellation or Confirmation request.

clearing_type.title: Clearing Type
clearing_type.description: Define whether the confirmation of the authorization will be performed online at request time or it will wait for a confirmation request. If not present, MTI is considered to define this behavior.

account_id.title: Account ID
account_id.description: Pismo ID of the account to be used as the owner of this request.

program_id.title: Program ID
program_id.description: Pismo ID of the program related to the owner of this request.

card_id.title: Card Identifier
card_id.description: Pismo ID of the card related to the owner of this request.

card_mode_id.title: Card Mode Identifier
card_mode_id.description: Pismo ID of the card mode related to the card used on this request.

document_number_present.title: Document Number Presence
document_number_present.description: Identifies whether the Document Number was present as the authorization identification of the account holder.

authentication_token_present.title: Authentication Token Presence
authentication_token_present.description: Identifies whether the Authentication Token was present as the authorization identification of the account holder.

processing_code.title: Processing Code
processing_code.description: Unique alphanumeric identifier that defines how the Pismo platform handles this financial authorization.

network.title: Network Identifier
network.description: Identify the Network/Partner where this request has come from.

card_number_present.title: Card Number Presence
card_number_present.description: Identifies whether the Card Number was present as the authorization identification of the account holder.

cvv2_present.title: Cvv2 Presence
cvv2_present.description: Identifies whether the CVV 2 was present as the cardholder verification method.

track1_data_present.title: Track1 Data Presence
track1_data_present.description: Identifies whether the Track1 Data was present as the cardholder verification method.

track2_data_present.title: Track1 Data Presence
track2_data_present.description: Identifies whether the Track2 Data was present as the cardholder verification method.

pin_present.title: Pin Block Presence
pin_present.description: Identifies whether the Pin Block was present as the cardholder verification method.

cryptogram_data_present.title: Pin Block Presence
cryptogram_data_present.description: Identifies whether the Cryptogram Data was present as the cardholder verification method.

merchant_id.title: Merchant Identifier
merchant_id.description: Identifies the card acceptor that defines the point of the transaction in both local and interchange environments. This is used as a merchant ID to uniquely identify the merchant in a POS transaction.

merchant_category_code.title: MCC
merchant_category_code.description: This is the classification (MCC) of the merchant’s type of business or service.

merchant_name.title: Merchant Name
merchant_name.description: Name of the Merchant where the authorization is performed.

merchant_city.title: Merchant City
merchant_city.description: City of the Merchant where the authorization is performed.

merchant_country.title: Merchant Country
merchant_country.description: Country Code of the Merchant where the authorization is performed.

merchant_terminal_id.title: Merchant Terminal ID
merchant_terminal_id.description: This uniquely identifies a terminal at the card acceptor location.

authorization_code.title: Authorization Code
authorization_code.description: Alphanumeric code generated in an authorization request and assigned to the authorization response. Used on cancellation or advices requests to match the original authorization.

response_code.title: Authorization Response Code
response_code.description: Response code indicating the decision taken over an authorization request. Used in advice requests to identify the decision taken outside Pismo platform.

denial_code.title: Authorization Denial Code
denial_code.description: Denial code that indicates the reason why the request was denied.

installment_plan_id.title: Installment Plan Identifier
installment_plan_id.description: Identifier of the installment plan that should be used to calculate this purchase.

nsu.title: NSU
nsu.description: Sequential unique number that identifies this authorization.

authorization_datetime.title: Acquirer Authorization Date Time
authorization_datetime.description: Date and time when the authorization request took place on acquirer side.

amount.title: Authorization Amount
amount.description: Total Amount of the authorization being requested in the local currency of the acquirer or source location of the transaction.

currency_code.title: Alphabetic authorization currency code
currency_code.description: ISO-4217 alphabetic code (3 characters) for local authorization's currency used in the `amount` field.

currency_num_code.title: Numeric authorization currency code
currency_num_code.description: ISO-4217 numeric code (3 digits) for local authorization's currency used in the `amount` field.

authorization_mode.title: Authorization Mode
authorization_mode.description: Defines the mode of the authorization being requested.

pre_authorization.title: Pre Authorization Indicator
pre_authorization.description: Defines whether this authorization request is a pre authorization or not.

number_of_installments.title: Number Of Installments
number_of_installments.description: Number of installments of this authorization request. Purchases without installments should have the value 1.

atc.title: Application transaction counter
atc.description: The ATC (application transaction counter) is a counter, maintained by the chip card application (incremented by the chip), that provides a sequential reference to each transaction.  This field is the ATC value for this card  on this authorization. Only authorization requests with cryptogram information contain this counter.

labels.title: Authorization Labels
labels.description: List with all labels related to this authorization. Each label identifies an authorization characteristic.

card_validations.title: Card validations
card_validations.description: Object Additional card validations data, if applicable.

bin.title: Card BIN
bin.description: Card BIN (Bank Identification Number) used in the authorization.

last_4_digits.title: Card last 4 digits
last_4_digits.description: Last 4 digits of the card used in the authorization.
